prompt: Create a transparent-background pixel-art atlas, exactly two rows by six square columns. Each row shows one exact source object in six fixed orthographic views ordered FRONT, TOP, RIGHT, LEFT, BOTTOM, REAR. Row 1: safe-services queue ticket dispenser, a red rectangular ticket box on a thin black pole and square weighted base with a small white ticket strip. Row 2: red candy vending machine with glass window full of colorful round candies, coin slot and dispensing tray. Preserve identity, colors, details, dimensions and exact object per row. Front/rear broad faces, top overhead caps/footprints, opposite side profiles, bottom base/underside only. The ticket strip must not appear from rear or underfoot; vending machine's candies appear through front glass only and do not leak into sides/rear. No perspective/isometric views, no extra objects, no text, no signs, labels, grid or background. Transparent empty gutters, one full centered uncropped silhouette per cell.
